name: GfG - Gesellschaft für Gerätebau mbH
summary: GfG - Gesellschaft für Gerätebau mbH specializes in gas detection solutions crucial for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products, including portable and fixed gas detectors, are designed to monitor and ensure safety in environments with toxic, corrosive, and combustible gases. With over 65 years of experience, GfG provides tailored solutions to meet the specific needs of semiconductor production facilities.
